*Auto-generated from CISA KEV, NVD and public advisories; summaries are AI-assisted.*

Today's KEV additions center on remote command execution and authentication weaknesses in infrastructure and communications products. Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series gained three entries (path traversal, command execution, and information exposure). Mitel MiCollab gained five, all in the AWV component, including two unauthenticated command-injection flaws (CVSS 9.8). HPE Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Router (root command injection, CVSS 9.8) and Vates Xen Orchestra (authentication bypass via a crafted token, CVSS 9.8) were also added. Separately, several non-KEV critical CVEs (CVSS 9.8–10.0) were disclosed, notably authentication bypass and command injection in HPE AirWave, plus flaws in Apache JSPWiki, pulp_python, Jenkins Script Security Plugin, and Budibase.

### Defender priorities

- Prioritize remediation of the ten newly listed KEV entries, starting with the Mitel MiCollab AWV, HPE Juniper Session Smart, and Xen Orchestra flaws, which are unauthenticated or root-level.
- Identify and restrict network exposure of Danfoss AK-SM 800A, MiCollab AWV, and Xen Orchestra instances, and review logs for signs of exploitation.
- Assess exposure to the critical non-KEV CVEs, particularly HPE AirWave management interfaces and the Jenkins Script Security Plugin, and patch or limit access to them.

## CISA KEV additions (10)

- **[CVE-2023-25914](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2023-25914/)** — Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series · CVSS 8.8
  A path traversal flaw in the Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series XML interface lets an attacker read underlying server system files. Listed as known exploited.
- **[CVE-2023-25915](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2023-25915/)** — Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series · CVSS 8.8
  Improper input validation in the Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series lets a remote attacker run arbitrary commands on the affected system. Listed as known exploited.
- **[CVE-2025-41450](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2025-41450/)** — Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series · CVSS 7.5
  Improper authentication in the Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series lets an attacker generate a web report exposing sensitive information such as internal IP addresses, usernames, and store names. Listed as known exploited.
- **[CVE-2026-103406](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-103406/)** — Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router · CVSS 9.8
  An OS command injection vulnerability in HPE Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router lets a remote attacker run arbitrary commands as root via a crafted salt minion ID. Listed as known exploited.
- **[CVE-2026-133275](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-133275/)** — Mitel MiCollab · CVSS 5.3
  Insufficient file type validation in Mitel MiCollab's AWV component lets an unauthenticated attacker upload arbitrary files. Listed as known exploited.
- **[CVE-2026-133303](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-133303/)** — Mitel MiCollab · CVSS 9.8
  An XML injection flaw in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab lets an unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary commands using pre-staged malicious content. Listed as known exploited.
- **[CVE-2026-133311](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-133311/)** — Mitel MiCollab · CVSS 5.9
  A weak authentication flaw in Mitel MiCollab's AWV component lets an unauthenticated attacker access sensitive information using a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content. Listed as known exploited.
- **[CVE-2026-133323](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-133323/)** — Mitel MiCollab · CVSS 9.8
  The Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab has insufficient parameter sanitization, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to perform blind command injection and run arbitrary commands on the system. Tracked by Mitel as MTLVULN-1864.
- **[CVE-2026-133324](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-133324/)** — Mitel MiCollab · CVSS 5.3
  Mitel MiCollab's Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component fails to fail securely, letting an unauthenticated attacker bypass authentication controls and perform unauthorized actions. It is listed as known exploited, so it is being used in real attacks.
- **[CVE-2026-133469](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-133469/)** — Vates Xen Orchestra · CVSS 9.8
  Xen Orchestra fails to properly validate the type of input in authentication tokens. An unauthenticated attacker can bypass authentication using a crafted token containing an empty JSON object and act with administrative privileges. Listed as known exploited.

## New critical CVEs (15)

- **[CVE-2026-78114](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-78114/)** — Apache Software Foundation Apache JSPWiki · CVSS 10.0
  Apache JSPWiki does not replace the session identifier when a user logs in, which is a session fixation flaw. An attacker who can set a known session ID in a victim's browser can reuse it after the victim authenticates.
- **[CVE-2026-126984](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-126984/)** — Pulp pulp_python · CVSS 10.0
  A server-side request forgery flaw in pulp_python's pull-through caching lets a network attacker supply the redirect query parameter as the URL the content app fetches and returns. This can expose internal resources reachable from the server, and the description suggests it may also involve the remote's credentials (the data is truncated).
- **[CVE-2026-136835](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-136835/)** — Jenkins Project Jenkins Script Security Plugin · CVSS 9.9
  Jenkins Script Security Plugin does not reject @Builder annotations that name an arbitrary class in builderStrategy when referenced by a partially qualified class name. Users who can define and run sandboxed scripts, including Pipelines, can escape the sandbox and execute code if a suitable class is on the classpath.
- **[CVE-2026-137498](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-137498/)** — budibase server · CVSS 9.9
  Budibase Server has a prototype pollution flaw where an unauthenticated attacker can supply __proto__ as a dynamic JSON key in PUBLIC queries, erasing MongoDB query filters. This lets a single request read, modify, or delete every document in a collection.
- **[CVE-2026-125812](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-125812)** — WP Media WP Rocket · CVSS 9.8
  Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in WP Media WP Rocket wp-rocket allows Path Traversal.This issue affects WP Rocket: from n/a before 3.24.2.
- **[CVE-2026-133467](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-133467/)** — Infinitode CodeSafe · CVSS 9.8
  CodeSafe's safe_eval() can be bypassed using indirect subscript calls such as builtins'exec', because AST validation only blocks direct calls to dangerous built-ins. An attacker controlling the evaluated expression can run arbitrary Python with the host application's permissions.
- **[CVE-2026-135400](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-135400/)** — ever-co ever-gauzy · CVSS 9.8
  In Ever Gauzy before 111.44.3, JWT validation accepts the user lookup result without checking that the user is active and not archived. When a token includes an organizationId claim, the active/archived check is applied only to the UserOrganization record, so deactivated or archived users may retain access.
- **[CVE-2026-133971](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-133971/)** — Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) HPE Networking Management Software AirWave · CVSS 9.8
  An authentication bypass in the web management interface of HPE Networking Management Software AirWave lets an unauthenticated remote attacker gain administrative access. This compromises the confidentiality and integrity of the AirWave system.
- **[CVE-2026-133972](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-133972/)** — Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) HPE Networking Management Software AirWave · CVSS 9.8
  A flaw in HPE Networking Management Software AirWave lets an attacker with network access bypass authentication. This could allow unauthorized actions that affect system integrity and confidentiality.
- **[CVE-2026-133973](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-133973/)** — Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) HPE Networking Management Software AirWave · CVSS 9.8
  A command injection flaw in the web management interface of HPE Networking Management Software AirWave lets an unauthenticated remote attacker run arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system. This affects the confidentiality, integrity and availability of the system.
- **[CVE-2026-123903](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-123903/)** — VMware VMware vCenter Server · CVSS 9.8
  VMware vCenter Server has an authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service, rated critical (CVSS 9.8). It matters because vCenter controls virtualized infrastructure.
- **[CVE-2026-123910](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-123910/)** — VMware VMware ESX · CVSS 9.8
  A heap out-of-bounds write in the ESX I/O filter service has a maximum CVSSv3 score of 9.8 and is rated Critical by Broadcom. It could compromise the hypervisor and the workloads running on it.
- **[CVE-2026-123911](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-123911/)** — VMware VMware ESX · CVSS 9.8
  A use-after-free in the ESX I/O filter service has a maximum CVSSv3 score of 9.8 and is rated Critical by Broadcom. It could compromise the hypervisor and the workloads running on it.
- **[CVE-2026-131767](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-131767/)** — Aman FunnelKit Automations · CVSS 9.8
  FunnelKit Automations deserializes untrusted data, which allows PHP object injection. This can let an attacker manipulate application objects and, depending on available code paths, severely compromise the site.
- **[CVE-2026-134481](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-134481/)** — Ultimate Member · CVSS 9.8
  The Ultimate Member WordPress plugin deserializes untrusted data, enabling PHP object injection. Depending on available gadget chains, this can lead to serious compromise of the site.
